title: Portland–Montreal pipeline

infobox.name: Portland–Montreal Pipe Line
infobox.caption: Portland Pipeline marine terminal in South Portland, ME
infobox.operator: Portland Pipe Line Corporation (in the United States); Montreal Pipe Line Limited (in Canada)

intro: The Portland Montreal Pipeline is a series of underground crude oil pipelines connecting South Portland, Maine, in the United States with Montreal, Quebec, in Canada. As of early 2016, the pipeline transports limited volumes, sufficient to keep the pipeline wet. The pipeline also supplied crude oil to the Suncor Montreal-Est refinery during supply interruptions due to the 2016 Fort McMurray wildfires.
